name: MacBook Pro 14" M2 Max
comments: Apple uses a 4-year lifespan for its life cycle analysis, adjusted to 5 years for my usage.
calculation_notes: Apple Product Environmental Report, 14-inch MacBook Pro (January 2023): 312 kg CO2e, use phase 20%, over Apple's 4-year assumption (800 working days).
Estimated lifespan raised to 5 years (1,000 working days) for my usage.
The in-box power adapter is likely included in Apple's figure (production covers all parts and packaging); not confirmed explicitly.
Power: 20 W x 8 h per working day.
water_per_day_l: origin not documented.
Daily CO2 = lifecycle_co2 x (1 - use_phase_percent) / effective lifespan + wattage x daily_hours x 0.0461 kg/kWh (co2.ts).

The manufacturer's use phase is removed and replaced with real consumption at the French grid mix: 46.1 gCO2e/kWh, ADEME Base Empreinte 'Electricite 2025 - mix moyen - consommation', smoothed over 2022-2025. All work happens in France.
Effective lifespan = max(estimated_lifespan_days, working days owned at the project date), with working days = calendar days x 5/7 (200 days/year).
manufacturer_lifespan_days is kept for reference; the calculation no longer uses it.

name: 34" Monitor
comments: No environmental report for this model. Based on an equivalent 34" curved monitor.
calculation_notes: Device: Huawei MateView GT 34 (not named publicly). Huawei publishes no carbon footprint for it.

Proxy: Dell S3422DW PCF (34-inch curved, 3440x1440, PAIA model v1.3.2, September 2022): mean 821 kg CO2e +/- 263 (5th-95th percentile 331-1,804), use phase 43.7% at the EU grid, 6 years (1,200 working days), 122 kWh/year.
Dell's use phase implies ~490 g/kWh (359 kg for 732 kWh); it is replaced by the French grid mix in co2.ts.

Cross-check: ADEME/impactco2 24-inch monitor (92.6 kg over 6 years) scaled by panel area (x1.67) gives ~155 kg; average TV (370 kg over 8 years) scaled (x0.48) gives ~176 kg. Dell's manufacturing share alone is ~460 kg (incl. 71 kg transport).
Power: 39 W from the EU energy label (39 kWh per 1,000 h), x 8 h per working day.
Estimated lifespan: 10 years (2,000 working days). Purchased January 2022.
water_per_day_l: origin not documented.

name: Accessories
description: Chargers, ISP box and other peripherals.
comments: Includes MacBook charger, ISP internet box and cables. Daily hours scoped to work use only.
calculation_notes: Internet box: ADEME/Arcep 2025 via impactco2.fr, 81.2 kg CO2e over 5 years, use 18.2 kg (22%). About 88% of the total.
Wired headset: Logitech G335 wired PCF (ISO 14067, DEKRA review), 7.14 kg CO2e over 2 years, use 20%. Used occasionally for calls, so likely overestimated.
Second MacBook charger (for client meetings): ~4 kg CO2e, estimate. The first charger is likely counted in Apple's MacBook report.
Total 92.3 kg, rounded to 92; weighted use phase 21%; manufacturer lifespan set to the box's 5 years (1,000 working days).
Purchase date 2016-10-01: average age of about 10 years (box ~12, charger ~11, headset ~9).
Power: 10 W x 8 h per working day, within the 3.6-25 W range Arcep measured for internet boxes. Daily hours scoped to work use only.
Daily CO2 = lifecycle_co2 x (1 - use_phase_percent) / effective lifespan + wattage x daily_hours x 0.0461 kg/kWh (co2.ts).

The manufacturer's use phase is removed and replaced with real consumption at the French grid mix: 46.1 gCO2e/kWh, ADEME Base Empreinte 'Electricite 2025 - mix moyen - consommation', smoothed over 2022-2025. All work happens in France.
